### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications establish a relationship where the IRQ handling functions (`ufshcd_enable_irq` and `ufshcd_disable_irq`) are now shared across multiple files. By exporting these functions from `ufshcd.c`, they can be utilized in `ufs-qcom.c`, which enhances code maintainability and reduces redundancy. The changes in `ufs-qcom.c` leverage the newly exported functions to manage IRQ states during the reset process, ensuring that the IRQ is only disabled or enabled through the centralized logic defined in `ufshcd.c`. This also addresses a potential bug related to redundant IRQ disabling before asserting a reset, as noted in the patch description.

```c
ufshcd_disable_irq(hba);
ufshcd_enable_irq(hba);
```
